name: GFMBench-API
description: Python interface that wraps existing genomic tasks (GUE, VariantBenchmarks, LRB, BEND, TraitGym, SongLab ClinVar, BRCA1, VEP-eval, LOL-EVE) and a new ClinVar indel task behind one evaluation API.

attributes.task: Supervised classification and zero-shot variant effect prediction on DNA sequence
attributes.scope_note: Tasks are re-implementations of existing benchmarks with some changes, for example fixed test folds instead of cross-validation for VariantBenchmarks.
attributes.source_locator: Technical Methods; Appendix task descriptions; Tables 1-5
